$comment: Reviewed license exceptions for scripts/check-licenses.mjs (plan open-source-release-2026-09-29 P-017, WI-10003906). An entry applies ONLY while the lockfile still declares exactly `declared`; a changed declaration fails the gate until re-reviewed. `license` = the SPDX expression verified by reading the package's real license text (then judged by the normal policy); `allow: true` = a deliberately permitted non-open dependency, with the reason. Never add an entry without reading the license text. Stale entries are reported; delete them.

@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.reason: Proprietary: Anthropic Commercial Terms of Service (LICENSE.md: 'All rights reserved. Use is subject to the Legal Agreements'). Permitted as a runtime dependency only: installed from npm by each user, never bundled into our installers (0.0.25 macOS Server.app has no @anthropic-ai entries). Terms review of how we authenticate: plan P-019.
